description: Author the 14 curated guide JSON files in shared/guides/, each researched against official documentation via web search/fetch, then verify every cited URL with the link checker. Depends on FEAT-001 (schema + check-links) and FEAT-002 (curated.test.ts validates them). Covers ACs 1, 2, 3. This is content research — cite ONLY URLs actually found/fetched; never invent URLs; honesty over polish.
steps: For each of the 14 slugs in design.md 'Curated guide content plan' (github, google-workspace, slack, notion, stripe-connect, shopify, discord, zoom, salesforce, hubspot, microsoft-entra, atlassian-jira, linear, figma): research the OAuth app setup + approval process against official docs. Start from the canonical official source URLs in design.md's source table and the content notes (HubSpot legacy-apps flow; Figma oauth-apps review question; moved-page corrections). Use web search/fetch to CONFIRM each page before citing it for a specific claim (current date 2026-10-20). Never cite a URL you did not actually retrieve.

Author each shared/guides/<slug>.json to the GuideInput authoring shape: app (name, website, category, brand {color hex, monogram}), summary, oauthAvailability, difficulty {level, reason}, timeEstimate {handsOn, approvalWait, criticalPath}, review {required, requiredWhen, types, stages}, prerequisites, steps (title, detail, consoleUrl|null, actor), redirectUris, scopes (recommended/sensitive/notes), blockers, agentHandoff, confidence (nine SECTION_KEYS with level/note/sourceRefs), verification (lastVerified YYYY-MM-DD >=2026-10-20, sources >=2 with >=1 kind:'official' all https, checked/corrected/uncertain), generatedBy:'curated', generatedAt UTC with Z suffix, model:null, query:null. Filename stem MUST equal slug.

Honesty rules: set approval-wait confidence to 'community' unless an official page states the figure; encode Figma review as uncertain (review.required:false, types:['other'], stages:[], confidence.review.level:'uncertain', a verification.uncertain entry) unless the oauth-apps page confirms a review (then switch to required:true, types:['app-review'], add a stage, log the correction). Keep the fixed difficulties GitHub=Easy, Google Workspace=Very Hard, Shopify=Hard, and ensure all four difficulty levels appear across the set. A section may be 'verified' ONLY when backed by an official sourceRef.

Add aliases (normalized [a-z0-9] keys) to every guide so common phrasings resolve to curated apps and never trigger a paid live run (NIT): include at least google-workspace -> google/gmail/googleworkspace/gsuite; microsoft-entra -> microsoft/azure/azuread/entra/msgraph/microsoftgraph/microsoft365/office365; atlassian-jira -> jira/atlassian/confluence; stripe-connect -> stripe; salesforce -> salesforce/sfdc. The brief specifically calls out 'Microsoft Entra ID', 'Azure AD', 'Atlassian Jira', 'Jira' — their normalized keys (microsoftentraid/azuread/atlassianjira/jira) must be covered by an alias or the normalized app name so curated.match() hits them.

Run `node scripts/sync-shared.mjs` to regenerate the generated copies with all 14 guides, then run `node scripts/check-links.mjs`. Replace any broken URL, update any redirected URL to its final URL (only after confirming the page still supports the claim), and downgrade any section citing only failed URLs below 'verified'. Record each correction in the guide's verification.corrected (the submission evidence log in FEAT-005 will reuse these).

Record in this FEAT's findings the per-guide difficulty/review settings actually chosen, any URL corrections made, and whether Figma's review question was resolved or left uncertain — FEAT-005's evidence-log content depends on this.
acceptance_criteria: `npm --prefix backend test -- curated` passes: all 14 guides valid against GuideSchema, unique slugs each equal to its filename stem, aliases don't collide across guides, >=2 sources each with >=1 official, every URL https, valid lastVerified dates, steps actors in {agent,human,assist}, all four difficulty levels present, GitHub/Google/Shopify are Easy/Very Hard/Hard, and every 'verified' section has >=1 official sourceRef (ACs 1, 2).
`node scripts/check-links.mjs` exits 0 (zero broken, zero missing) and writes shared/link-check-report.json with one result per collected URL (AC 3).
Every cited URL was actually retrieved during research; no invented URLs appear in any guide.

curated.match() resolves the normalized keys for 'Microsoft Entra ID', 'Azure AD', 'Atlassian Jira', and 'Jira' to the correct curated guide (asserted by an alias/name check in curated.test.ts or a quick node check).
verification: node scripts/check-links.mjs exits 0 with zero broken and zero missing URLs
findings:
All 14 curated guides authored in shared/guides/ and validated: `node scripts/sync-shared.mjs` exits 0, `npm --prefix backend test -- curated` passes all 6 assertions, and `node scripts/check-links.mjs` exits 0 (50 URLs: ok=46, redirected=4, blocked=0, broken=0). curated.match() resolves 'Microsoft Entra ID'->microsoft-entra, 'Azure AD'->microsoft-entra, 'Atlassian Jira'->atlassian-jira, 'Jira'->atlassian-jira (verified via tsx).

Per-guide difficulty + review settings chosen:
- github: Easy, review.required=false, types=[none]. Instant, no approval gate.
- google-workspace: Very Hard, review.required=true, types=[oauth-verification, security-assessment]. CASA for restricted scopes + annual re-verification.
- slack: Moderate, review.required=false, types=[optional-listing]. Private install review-free; Marketplace review optional (up to 10 business days preliminary + up to 10 weeks functional; 10+ active-workspace prerequisite confirmed).
- notion: Easy, review.required=false, types=[optional-listing]. No mandatory review; page-sharing-with-connection is the key gotcha.
- stripe-connect: Moderate, review.required=false, types=[platform-onboarding]. No integration review; connected-account onboarding/verification is the only wait.
- shopify: Hard, review.required=true, types=[partner-program, app-review]. Public App Store review + separate protected-customer-data approval.
- discord: Easy, review.required=false, types=[other]. No starting review; bot verification past 100 servers and approval-gated scopes noted.
- zoom: Hard, review.required=true, types=[app-review]. Multi-part Marketplace review incl. OWASP Top 10 security review.
- salesforce: Moderate, review.required=false, types=[optional-listing]. In-org use needs no review; AppExchange review separate. Propagation delay (2-10 min) is the only in-org wait.
- hubspot: Moderate, review.required=false, types=[optional-listing]. Standard OAuth; Marketplace listing optional.
- microsoft-entra: Hard, review.required=true, types=[publisher-verification, admin-consent]. Multitenant distribution gated by publisher verification + per-tenant admin consent.
- atlassian-jira: Moderate, review.required=false, types=[optional-listing]. 3LO needs no mandatory review; single distributable app required by policy.
- linear: Easy, review.required=false, types=[none]. Standard OAuth2 with PKCE + actor param; no review.
- figma: Moderate, review.required=TRUE, types=[app-review]. See Figma resolution below.
All four difficulty levels present (Easy x4, Moderate x6, Hard x3, Very Hard x1). Fixed pins honored: GitHub=Easy, Google=Very Hard, Shopify=Hard.

FIGMA REVIEW QUESTION RESOLVED (not left uncertain): the official oauth-apps page (developers.figma.com/docs/rest-api/oauth-apps/) states that public OAuth apps ARE reviewed by Figma on publish and can only authorize users after Figma approves them (private/draft apps are not reviewed). Per the design content note, Figma was switched from the uncertain encoding to review.required=true, types=[app-review], with a 'Public app publish review' stage; confidence.review.level='verified'; the switch is logged in figma.json verification.corrected and the approval-wait duration (Figma publishes no fixed turnaround) is kept community/uncertain.

URL corrections / notes recorded in each guide's verification.corrected (for FEAT-005 evidence log):
- slack: docs moved api.slack.com -> docs.slack.dev (cited current URLs).
- stripe-connect: docs moved stripe.com/docs -> docs.stripe.com (cited current URLs).
- hubspot: OAuth docs now under legacy-apps/ path (reflects move to newer projects platform); cited current legacy-apps URLs. New-vs-legacy flow for a brand-new app left as a documented uncertain.
- discord: dev docs moved discord.com/developers/docs -> docs.discord.com/developers (cited current URLs).
- google-workspace: verification help now at support.google.com/cloud/answer/13463073 (older drafts used answer/9110914).
- microsoft-entra: Azure AD renamed to Microsoft Entra ID; cited learn.microsoft.com/entra identity-platform URLs. app.website redirect learn.microsoft.com -> learn.microsoft.com/en-us/ fixed.
- zoom: app.website redirect zoom.us -> www.zoom.com fixed.
- notion: app.website redirect www.notion.so -> www.notion.com fixed.
- figma: review question resolution logged (see above).

Link-check report (shared/link-check-report.json) regenerated and committed-ready. Remaining 4 'redirected' entries are all benign and intentionally NOT changed: github.com/settings/developers (auth/login gate on the correct console URL); and slack.com, stripe.com, www.salesforce.com (region/locale geo redirects that differ per reviewer region, so updating to a geo-specific URL would be incorrect). No 'blocked' entries in the current report. Note: developer.salesforce.com returned HTTP 403 to automated fetch during research (bot protection) but returned ok=200 to the link checker's browser-like User-Agent; it is cited as official and confirmed reachable, with the 403-on-automated-fetch caveat recorded in salesforce.json verification.uncertain.

Every cited source URL was actually retrieved during research (web_fetch) before being cited for its section's claim; no invented URLs. Per-section confidence set honestly: approval-wait figures and author-estimated hands-on times are 'community'; sections backed by an official page that states the claim are 'verified'; Figma review is 'verified' (resolved), and genuinely open questions (HubSpot new-vs-legacy flow, exact review durations) are 'uncertain' with verification.uncertain entries.

NOTE (out of FEAT-003 scope): the full backend suite has 5 unrelated failures from unimplemented features - 4 in deployFiles.test.ts (backend/.env.example and render.yaml do not exist yet = FEAT-011) and 1 BUSY-concurrency case in routes.test.ts (generate pipeline/middleware). None touch curated guide content; all FEAT-003 verification commands pass.
